meta.title: 回杯技巧：倾斜身体
meta.title_en: The Cup-Return Trick: Lean Your Body
meta.topic: 咖啡拉花 · 回杯技巧

scenes.context: 回杯：杯子从90度开始，回正到水平。拉花结束时要让杯子从倾斜回正到水平，收尾干净。语域：咖啡教学，动作讲解。
sentences: 回杯，杯子从90度回正到水平。
The return: bring the cup from 90° back to level.
The cup is tilted to make the art.
Returning levels it for a clean finish.
paraphrase: 回杯 → the cup return / bring it back
回正到水平 → back to level / straighten it out
scenes.speak: The return: bring the cup from 90° back to level. The cup is tilted to make the art. Returning levels it for a clean finish.

scenes.title_cn: 用身体倾斜代替手腕转动
scenes.title_en: Lean Your Body, Not Your Wrist
scenes.context: 用身体倾斜来代替手腕转动的回杯。很多人用手腕转动回杯，动作生硬；用身体带动更稳更自然。语域：咖啡教学，技巧对比。
sentences: 用身体倾斜，代替手腕转动。
Lean your body instead of turning your wrist.
instead of turning your wrist（代替手腕转动）
手腕转动，容易动作生硬。
Wrist turning often makes the motion stiff.
Body-led motion is steadier and more natural.
paraphrase: 身体倾斜 → lean your body / tilt from the shoulders
lean your body · tilt from shoulders
手腕转动 → wrist turning / rotate the wrist
scenes.speak: Lean your body instead of turning your wrist. Wrist turning often makes the motion stiff. Body-led motion is steadier and more natural.

practice: The return: bring the cup from 90° back to level.
Lean your body instead of turning your wrist.
pitfalls: Bring the cup from 90° back to level.
「回正到水平」用 back to level。
Lean your body instead of turning your wrist.
「用身体倾斜代替手腕」用 lean your body instead of turning your wrist。
Wrist turning often makes the motion stiff.
Body-led motion is steadier and more natural.
shifts: 用 the cup return（回杯）、back to level（回正）、tilted（倾斜）
用 lean your body（身体倾斜）、instead of turning your wrist（代替转手腕）、body-led motion（身体带动）
用 a clean finish（干净收尾）、steady（稳）、natural（自然）
